scene_prompt: Create a 3D open-sea boat racing map with a straight race course from a clear starting line to a distant finish line. Four boats line up side by side at the start, each carrying a red-and-yellow fast-food-inspired mascot or sign with visible text reading "inspired by McDonald."
agent_notes: A boat race with a start line and a finish line is Racing, and the answer chose one straight run over laps, so route-point-to-point with the Sprint / Drag preset, which is the genre's start-line-to-finish-line build. Added spawn-grid because the prompt itself says the boats are in line to start, which is the evenly spaced launch front rather than a single start marker, and water-body for the open-sea setting the answer picked; lane-corridor is bent to buoy lines marking the allowed racing corridor rather than pool ropes. The CHECK from the water is nominal and should clear: the boats race across one representable sea surface with nothing layered above or below it. Two things no field carries, recorded here: four boats line up at the start, and the prompt wants a McDonald's-styled figure aboard every boat with text reading inspired by McDonald, which is prop dressing on the racers rather than any layout option.
